title: Spectral Muse of Paris
description: A glowing translucent woman with long white hair stands in the center of a surreal Parisian street, wearing a dress made of vibrant orange flowers. She emits purple energy as black shards float around her, with a bright sun, red sky, flying books, and the Sacré-Cœur Basilica visible in the background.
prompt: A translucent glowing woman with flowing white hair stands in the middle of a cobblestone Parisian street, her orange flower dress radiating magic. Purple energy swirls around her as black glass shards float in the air. Behind her is a dramatic red and orange sunset sky with a radiant sun, the white Sacré-Cœur Basilica on a hill, flying books, ravens, and quaint shops with stained glass windows lining the street.
